جُمْسَةٌ A tough date: (IDrd, * M, K, * TA:) a date ripening (As, S, Z, K) altogether, (As, Z, K, TA,) but as yet hard, not mellow, or digestible, or easy of digestion: (As, S, Z, K:) pl. جُمَسٌ. (As, TA.) [See بُسْرٌ.] ＝
-A2- Also A distinct number, or herd, of camels. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
